parts.name: goat
sources: Quaternius, Animal Pack Vol.2 (2017): Dog.fbx. https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A goat of Việt Nam (dê cỏ): a small goat, about 55 cm at the shoulder, brown with a dark back, hooves, small horns, a short tail up.
A goat of Việt Nam (dê cỏ): a small local goat, 50 to 60 cm at the shoulder, 25 to 40 kg. The numbers of the shape are a guess from these sizes and from photos.
